sentences.text:
Urmila Devi & Ors vs Unknown on 5 December, 2025
05.12.2025
Item No.8
Ct. No. 34
 nb
 Crr 4508 of 2025

In the matter of: Urmila Devi & Ors.
 ...... petitioners.

Mr. Dr. Achin Jana,
 Mr. Prosenjit Ghosh,
 Ms. Chetna Tustagi,
 ....For the Petitioners.

1.
This is an application for quashing of the criminal proceeding filed by the present petitioners, who
are the grandmother in law and father in law.

2.  It is submitted on behalf of the learned counsel representing the petitioners that the marriage was held in the 2020 and subsequently one matrimonial suit was filed for dissolution of marriage in the Month of September 2022, which was withdrawn in the year 2023 due to intervention of the family member.
After that the opposite party completely changed and later on again she lodged the complaint against the present petitioners falsely implicating them as accused person.
On completion of the investigation, the charge sheet has been submitted only under Section 498A.
The petitioner has also filed a matrimonial suit for a decree of divorce.

3. It is further submitted that no specific allegations are levelled against the present petitioners with no ingredients to attract Section 498A. Hence prayed for quashing of the proceeding.
4.

Heard the submission and perused the contents of the complaint lodged by the de facto complainant attributing the allegations levelled against the petitioner, which prima facie do not appear to be sufficient to attract Section 498A of the Indian Penal Code.
Therefore, the petitioner have been established to make out an arguable case, which is to be heard.
5. The petitioner is directed to serve notice upon the opposite parties with Speed Post with AD and office of the Public Prosecutor, and file affidavit of service on the next date of hearing.
6. In the meantime, all further proceeding of the learned Trial Court be stayed till February 15, 2026 or until further order whichever is earlier.

7. Let the matter placed before the Regular Bench.
